title: AI基础设施与Agentic AI驱动云计算结构性变革，数据主权与安全风险凸显
core_insight: 云厂商正加速AI基础设施整合，Spanner多模型数据库、边缘主权AI部署与AI Agent开发平台成为支撑Agentic AI时代的关键结构性突破，同时数据安全与合规风险显著上升

dimension_texts.technology: GKE Inference Gateway统一实时与异步推理，GKE Active Buffer优化工作负载扩展性能，Cloudflare Dynamic Workers实现AI生成代码安全沙盒执行性能提升100倍，AWS ECS Managed Daemons提升容器编排运维效率 Spanner多模型数据库在Agentic AI时代展现结构性优势，支持关系型、文档型和图数据模型的统一处理；微软发布三个新基础模型强化AI基础设施；Cloudflare Gen13服务器采用AMD EPYC Turin处理器实现边缘计算性能翻倍 Run real-time and async inference on the same infrastructure with GKE Inference Gateway Spanner's multi-model advantage for the era of agentic AI Sandboxing AI agents, 100x faster Launching Cloudflare’s Gen 13 servers: trading cache for cores for 2x edge compute performance Uplevel your workload scaling performance with GKE active buffer Announcing managed daemon support for Amazon ECS Managed Instances Microsoft takes on AI rivals with three new foundational models What’s new with Microsoft in open-source and Kubernetes at KubeCon + CloudNativeCon Europe 2026 Advancing agentic AI with Microsoft databases across a unified data estate DeerFlow 2.0 开源升级：依托 Harness，让 Agent 不再"半途而废"
dimension_texts.infrastructure: 微软与Armada合作推出Azure Local on Galleon模块化数据中心，实现边缘主权AI部署；AWS推出可持续性控制台整合Scope 1-3碳排放报告；微软强调数字主权作为区域扩张关键考量 Cloudflare Gen13服务器采用AMD EPYC Turin处理器；AWS Weekly Roundup提及NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Super登陆Amazon Bedrock；微软与NVIDIA合作推进Azure AI基础设施和Physical AI解决方案 Building sovereign AI at the edge: Microsoft and Armada collaborate to deliver Azure Local on Galleon modular datacenters Announcing the AWS Sustainability console: Programmatic access, configurable CSV reports, and Scope 1–3 reporting in one place Launching Cloudflare’s Gen 13 servers: trading cache for cores for 2x edge compute performance AWS Weekly Roundup: NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Super on Amazon Bedrock, Nova Forge SDK, Amazon Corretto 26, and more Navigating digital sovereignty at the frontier of transformation Microsoft at NVIDIA GTC: New solutions for Microsoft Foundry, Azure AI infrastructure and Physical AI How AI-powered tools are driving the next wave of sustainable infrastructure and reporting Inside Gen 13: how we built our most powerful server yet
dimension_texts.application: Salesforce Agentforce在客户服务场景实现82%问题转偏率；Honeylove案例显示AI数据分析在消费品制造质量管控的应用；火山引擎推出短剧生产Agent「火山剧创」；微软将AI应用于核能行业 Salesforce推出Agent2Agent和Model Context Protocol等新一代集成模式；火山引擎通过CodingPlan + Agents重构AI开发范式；企业AI应用从实验转向生产环境，数据层激活成为AI就绪关键步骤 Proving the Power of Script: How Datasite Agents Achieved 82% Deflection and 4.8/5 CSAT How Honeylove boosts product quality and service efficiency with BigQuery 接入Seedance 2.0，短剧生产Agent「火山剧创」正式邀测 AI for nuclear energy: Powering an intelligent, resilient future How to Choose the Right Integration Pattern for Agentforce 从"单兵作战"到团队协作：Coding Plan + Agents 团队重构 AI 开发范式 Activating Your Data Layer for Production-Ready AI Amazon and Chobani adopt Strella's AI interviews for customer research 火山引擎正式推出四款数据产品 将持续完善敏捷数智引擎矩阵
